id: title:Gilbert09:keep syncs enabled on transient errors

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability and recovery for PostgreSQL, Ahrefs, Cloudflare, Linear, and Snapchat Ads connectors.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates substantive, bounded improvements to warehouse ingestion reliability. P1.F21 and P1.F24 show complete implementation of retryable classifications for PostgreSQL connection timeouts and Snapchat 401 errors, allowing ingestion jobs to recover rather than permanently fail. P1.F10 and P1.F11 show configuration and test changes supporting Cloudflare account fanout
review.uncertainty: Several hunks (P1.F1, P1.F15, P1.F16) are explicitly noted as lacking complete implementation or helper function bodies, preventing a definitive assessment of the full behavior and relationship to the rest of the codebase. While P1.F21 and P1.F24 support a score of 2, the incomplete implementation in other hunks prevents assigning a score of 3. No score multiplication or tier-mixin
